info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Support Tickets Escalates-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Escalation API allows users to retrieve a list of support tickets that have been escalated for further attention. This is essential for maintaining service quality and ensuring that critical issues are addressed promptly. Typical consumers include support staff and managers who need to monitor high-priority ticket status and performance. By leveraging this API, teams can efficiently track escalated tickets and take necessary actions to resolve them faster.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to escalate an existing support ticket to a higher priority or to notify a superior handler for more urgent attention.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to escalate a ticket within the ticketing system. Ensure that all required fields are filled out to successfully escalate the ticket.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning ticket escalation details.
